verdict.rationale: Temporal is built for autonomous background execution. Schedules start Workflow Executions at set or recurring times and are more flexible than cron (temporal-docs-15, temporal-docs-16, temporal-docs-25, corroborated by temporal-comm-8). Durable execution with automatic retries resumes work after crashes (temporal-docs-1, temporal-docs-10, temporal-docs-40), and it explicitly targets orchestrating AI agents (temporal-docs-19). Missing for 10: automations must be written as code rather than set up through no-code or natural-language tools (temporal-docs-11), and hands-on reports describe workflows stuck 'In Progress' with errors buried in the event log (temporal-comm-3, temporal-comm-4).
